info.name: Ahmad Adlouni
info.position: Senior Software Engineer at Siren Analytics

paragraphs: 👋 Hi! I'm a **Senior Software Engineer** at [Siren Analytics](https://sirenanalytics.com) with 7+ years of experience building responsive, accessible and scalable web applications for government, enterprise and digital-service platforms.

I specialise in **Angular, TypeScript and frontend architecture**, with deep experience in dynamic multi-step forms, configurable form-builder tools, dashboards, workflow interfaces and API integration. 💻

I've delivered bilingual Arabic/English (RTL) public-sector portals integrated with national government systems, offline-capable Progressive Web Apps for field data collection, and secure frontends hardened against penetration-test findings. 🚀
I'm comfortable across the full delivery lifecycle: requirements, prototyping, development, UAT, deployment, documentation, training and post-launch support. 📚
about.signOff: Welcome to my portfolio, where code meets creativity! ✨

experience.summary: Lead frontend development for public-sector platforms and government service-delivery systems in Jordan and Lebanon, working with backend, QA, design and business-analysis teams. Promoted to Senior Software Engineer in November 2024.
highlights: **MoDEE–EMRC e-Licensing Portal (Jordan):** dozens of bilingual (Arabic/English) licensing and renewal services, with multi-step forms validated in real time against national registries through the Government Service Bus.

**DAEM National Social Assistance Platform (Lebanon):** main frontend developer across four Angular apps, including an offline-capable field-survey PWA and a citizen portal with QR and PDF417 ID-card scanning.
Led **Form Studio**, a drag-and-drop form builder library shared across the DAEM apps, and the UI/UX revamp of three portals under one shared theme.
**PAX Foundation Project Management System:** applicant and back-office portals with phased review workflows, map-based project search and an AI assistant chat.
Remediated penetration-test findings (token storage, XSS, exposed file access) and added reCAPTCHA and session auto-logout.

experience.position: Software Engineer, Senior UI & Front-End Engineer
experience.summary: Owned the complete software development life cycle for the VestaPay product, from analysis to testing, using Java, GWT, Spring Boot and Oracle Database.

Developed Dialogflow CX chatbots on the Twilio Conversations API, extended with external APIs and webhooks.
Implemented a Node.js/Express server with JWT authentication and HTTPS.

description: A reusable, configurable drag-and-drop form builder for designing dynamic multi-step forms and workflows (DAEM, Siren Analytics), packaged as a standalone library (v1.0) and shared across the WFPS portal, an offline-capable field-survey PWA and the citizen registration portal.
techDescription: Builder: drag-and-drop and click-to-add palette, grid layouts, repeatable sections, steppers with step reordering, a visual conditional-logic builder, validation rules, a validation dependency graph, and JSON and consistency-rule code editors (CodeMirror).

Workflow: draft, publish and archive layout versions per survey type, clone layouts across survey types, export/import configurations between environments, permission-gated actions and a guided product tour.

Runtime: a reusable application renderer with responsive and RTL/LTR preview, lookup data sources, file uploads, camera and barcode scanner fields, resumable linear steppers and a read-only document view of submitted applications.

Extensible through runtime APIs for custom fields, property panels, event handlers and consistency rules; includes an AI form-assistant panel whose responses are validated against a schema before being applied.
Built with Angular, TypeScript, Angular Formly, RxJS and SCSS, with Karma/Jasmine tests and bilingual (Arabic/English) user and developer documentation.
